command:
set +e
set -uo pipefail
export TMPDIR=/tmp HOME=/tmp MAMBA_ROOT_PREFIX=/tmp/mamba
cd /tmp
# spawn runs task commands under bash -e; `set -uo pipefail` does not clear it (spawn#707).
SUB=linux-$( [ "$(uname -m)" = aarch64 ] && echo aarch64 || echo 64 )
echo "== FSL from the staged packages, offline ($SUB) =="
awk -v d=/tmp/pkgs/$SUB '/^https?:/{n=split($0,a,"/"); split(a[n],b,"#"); print "file://" d "/" b[1] "#" b[2]; next} {print}' "/tmp/locks/fsl-$SUB.lock" > local.lock
micromamba create -y -q -p /tmp/fsl --offline -f local.lock > install.log 2>&1 \
  || { echo "FAIL: FSL did not install from the staged, lock-verified packages"; tail -20 install.log; exit 1; }
export FSLDIR=/tmp/fsl PATH=/tmp/fsl/bin:$PATH FSLOUTPUTTYPE=NIFTI_GZ
. $FSLDIR/etc/fslconf/fsl.sh
S=$FSLDIR/data/standard
vol() { fslstats "$1" -V | awk '{print $1}'; }

echo "== 1. BET against FSL's own MNI152 brain mask, and a graded control on -f =="
for f in 0.2 0.5 0.8; do bet $S/MNI152_T1_1mm.nii.gz bet_$f -m -f $f >/dev/null 2>&1; done
REF=$(vol $S/MNI152_T1_1mm_brain_mask); A=$(vol bet_0.5_mask)
fslmaths bet_0.5_mask -mul $S/MNI152_T1_1mm_brain_mask ov; O=$(vol ov)
V2=$(vol bet_0.2_mask); V8=$(vol bet_0.8_mask)

echo "== 2. FLIRT undoes a planted rigid motion on the MNI152 template =="
T=$S/MNI152_T1_2mm_brain
# 6 deg about z through the image centre, plus (4.0, -2.5, 3.0) mm: M = T(c+t) R T(-c), FSL mm coordinates
awk -v th=6 -v cx=90 -v cy=108 -v cz=90 -v tx=4.0 -v ty=-2.5 -v tz=3.0 'BEGIN{
  r = th * 3.14159265358979323846 / 180; c = cos(r); s = sin(r)
  ox = cx - (c*cx - s*cy) + tx; oy = cy - (s*cx + c*cy) + ty; oz = tz
  printf "%.12f %.12f 0 %.12f\n%.12f %.12f 0 %.12f\n0 0 1 %.12f\n0 0 0 1\n", c, -s, ox, s, c, oy, oz }' > planted.mat
flirt -in $T -ref $T -applyxfm -init planted.mat -interp trilinear -out moving >/dev/null 2>&1
flirt -in moving -ref $T -dof 6 -omat recovered.mat -out recovered >/dev/null 2>&1 \
  || { echo "FAIL: flirt did not run"; exit 1; }
convert_xfm -omat residual.mat -concat recovered.mat planted.mat
flirt -in $T -ref $T -dof 6 -omat self.mat >/dev/null 2>&1

awk -v REF=$REF -v A=$A -v O=$O -v V2=$V2 -v V8=$V8 '
function rd(file, M,   l, i, n, f) { i = 0; while ((getline l < file) > 0) { n = split(l, f, " "); if (n >= 4) { i++; M[i,1]=f[1]; M[i,2]=f[2]; M[i,3]=f[3]; M[i,4]=f[4] } } close(file) }
function ab(x) { return x < 0 ? -x : x }
function cornerdisp(M,   x, y, z, i, j, k, d, dx, dy, dz, best) {   # max |(M - I) p| over the 2 mm volume corners, mm
  best = 0
  for (i = 0; i <= 1; i++) for (j = 0; j <= 1; j++) for (k = 0; k <= 1; k++) {
    x = i * 180; y = j * 216; z = k * 180
    dx = M[1,1]*x + M[1,2]*y + M[1,3]*z + M[1,4] - x; dy = M[2,1]*x + M[2,2]*y + M[2,3]*z + M[2,4] - y; dz = M[3,1]*x + M[3,2]*y + M[3,3]*z + M[3,4] - z
    d = sqrt(dx*dx + dy*dy + dz*dz); if (d > best) best = d }
  return best }
BEGIN {
  ok = 1
  dice = 2 * O / (A + REF); recall = O / REF
  printf "bet_vs_fsl_mask       Dice %.4f; contains %.4f of FSL'"'"'s mask (%d of %d voxels); BET mask %d voxels\n", dice, recall, O, REF, A
  printf "bet_f_ladder          -f 0.2: %d   0.5: %d   0.8: %d voxels\n", V2, A, V8
  if (!(recall >= 0.99)) { print "FAIL: BET'"'"'s brain does not contain FSL'"'"'s published brain mask (" recall ")"; ok = 0 }
  if (!(dice >= 0.95))   { print "FAIL: BET agrees with FSL'"'"'s mask at Dice " dice " only"; ok = 0 }
  if (!(V2 > A && A > V8)) { print "FAIL: BET'"'"'s brain volume is not monotone decreasing in -f, which is what -f controls"; ok = 0 }
  rd("planted.mat", P); rd("residual.mat", R); rd("self.mat", Sf)
  pd = cornerdisp(P); rdisp = cornerdisp(R); sd = cornerdisp(Sf)
  printf "flirt_planted         moves the volume corners by up to %.3f mm\n", pd
  printf "flirt_residual        recovered . planted moves them by %.4f mm (bound 0.5 mm = a quarter voxel)\n", rdisp
  printf "flirt_self            self-registration moves them by %.4f mm\n", sd
  if (!(rdisp < 0.5)) { print "FAIL: FLIRT left " rdisp " mm of the planted motion"; ok = 0 }
  if (!(pd > 10))     { print "FAIL: the planted motion is too small (" pd " mm) to test recovery"; ok = 0 }
  if (!(sd < 0.5))    { print "FAIL: registering the template to itself moved it " sd " mm"; ok = 0 }
  if (!ok) exit 1
  print "FSL OK"
}' 2>&1 | tee smoke-check.txt
test "${PIPESTATUS[0]}" = "0" || { echo "FAIL: an FSL check failed"; for f in planted.mat recovered.mat residual.mat; do echo "-- $f"; cat $f; done; exit 1; }
cp bet_0.5_mask.nii.gz bet_mask.nii.gz
# Versions from the install itself, written unconditionally: a minimal install has no
# $FSLDIR/etc/fslversion, and a missing declared output fails stage-out -- a descriptive line
# must never be able to fail the run.
{ micromamba list -p /tmp/fsl 2>/dev/null | awk '$1 ~ /^fsl/ {printf "%s\t%s\n", $1, $2}'; echo "arch	$(uname -m)"; } > fslversion.txt
test -s fslversion.txt || echo "versions unavailable" > fslversion.txt
uname -m | awk '{print "arch\t"$1}'
echo "DONE"
